title: event
description: One line of the event log (.harness/events.jsonl), one branch per kind. A human and tool mirror of the loader's exact key set per kind; the crate does not interpret this file, and a test pins each branch's required set to the loader's. A line is at most 4096 bytes including its newline.

oneOf.title: escalation
oneOf.description: A fix-round cap was reached and the ticket was escalated.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

run_id.description: The identity of the run that wrote this event; self-issued or inherited, never guessed.

role.description: The role of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

model.description: The model of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

oneOf.title: replan_required
oneOf.description: The ticket must be re-planned before more work is done on it.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

run_id.description: The identity of the run that wrote this event; self-issued or inherited, never guessed.

role.description: The role of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

model.description: The model of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

oneOf.title: budget_exceeded
oneOf.description: The ticket went over its budget and was stopped.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

run_id.description: The identity of the run that wrote this event; self-issued or inherited, never guessed.

role.description: The role of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

model.description: The model of the run that wrote this event; never defaulted.

oneOf.title: run_issued
oneOf.description: A run identity was self-issued for an event-writing invocation; the first line such an invocation appends.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

run_id.description: The id being issued; unique per issue (never the timestamp alone).

role.description: The role of the run being issued; never defaulted.

model.description: The model of the run being issued; never defaulted.

oneOf.title: session_started
oneOf.description: A session was started: a worker launched by the supervisor, or the interactive session at host hook time.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

session_id.description: Full lowercase uuid of the session; a short id is refused.

source.description: Whether the id came from a supervisor launch or the host's hook payload.

oneOf.title: unmanaged_session
oneOf.description: A process reported a ticket's worker id but was not launched by the supervisor, or a session started by hand with no launch-record row.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

session_id.description: Full lowercase uuid of the session.

ticket.description: The ticket (or phase id) the claimant reported.

reason.description: Which of the two sourced triggers refused the claimant.

oneOf.title: launch_refused
oneOf.description: A builder-state list entry matched, so the launch was refused and nothing was started.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

launch_role.description: The role of the refused session (the writer's role is the envelope's, not this).

brief_sha256.description: sha256 of the brief file, by the launch-row analogy.

matched_entry.description: The NAME of the config builder-state entry that matched, never the matched text (which can be a private path).

oneOf.title: timed_out
oneOf.description: The Process Supervisor (not the worker) stopped a run that timed out or died, leaving a continuation recipe.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

ticket.description: The ticket the run belonged to.

repo.description: The repository the run worked in.

checkpoint.description: The last pushed checkpoint commit (the workspace base sha when none was ever pushed).

recipe.description: The fixed continuation recipe token; inline recipe text is impossible in this format.

handover.description: Relative path to the handover file the resumed run starts from.

session_id.description: Full lowercase uuid of the worker session that timed out or died.

oneOf.title: check_in
oneOf.description: A worker past its soft step limit checked in and the job continued.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

ticket.description: The ticket the job belongs to.

repo.description: The repository the job works in.

soft_limit.description: The soft limit that was crossed.

oneOf.title: step_limit_stop
oneOf.description: A worker hit its hard step limit and stopped.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

ticket.description: The ticket the job belongs to.

repo.description: The repository the job works in.

hard_limit.description: The hard limit that stopped the job.

oneOf.title: cleanup_result
oneOf.description: The finalize step's cleanup outcome; a ticket is only marked Done after a pass.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

manifest_left.description: Resource-manifest entries still present; 0 is the empty state. A pass with entries left is refused by the loader.

oneOf.title: quarantined
oneOf.description: An item was moved to the quarantine folder, not deleted.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

ticket.description: The ticket whose harness root the item was found under.

from.description: Where the item was (the under-harness-root bound is the writer's rule; the loader checks the relpath shape).

to.description: Where it was moved to, under the quarantine folder (the bound is the writer's rule; the loader checks the relpath shape).

reason.description: An unmanifested planted item, or evidence moved past its retention.

oneOf.title: human_origin_refused
oneOf.description: A config, permission or control-registry write was refused because no human origin was proven for it.

v.description: Schema version. A reader refuses any other value (a v1 line is never upgraded).

path.description: Relative path of the target file under the harness root, never its content.
